User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores user profile information, including display name and online status.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

isOnline.description: Whether the user is currently online.

lastSeen.description: The last time the user was active.

Message.title: Chat Message
Message.description: Represents a message sent in a room or private chat.

senderName.description: The display name of the sender.

roomId.description: The ID of the room (or 'private:uid1:uid2' for private chats).

description.description: A brief description of the room.

createdBy.description: The UID of the user who created the room.

/private_chats/{chatId}/messages/{messag.description: Messages in private chats. chatId is typically 'uid1_uid2' sorted alphabetically.
